status: design-plan-only; authored transition frames and native fitting pending
units: H = common authored character height, not per-frame alpha bounding-box height

coupling.rate_change: scale cycle progression and desktop displacement together; never speed up only the window
coupling.contact_frame: world foot anchor = root position + local sole point; locked for the stance interval
coupling.ground: author common floor and left/right sole/heel/toe anchors; never recalculate ground from loose hair or crop bottom

transitions.rule: Start displacement with the free leg's first step; retain support foot world position until lift.

transitions.entry_phase: next near or far contact, keep lead-foot parity
transitions.rule: Finish weight transfer, then collect the trailing foot; settle hair/apron after body stops.

transitions.entry_phase: same leading-foot contact in both gaits
transitions.rule: Match shared height, camera and planted sole before the first flight phase. Do not dissolve two faces over each other.
Reduce cadence and displacement together after landing; keep the landing sole anchored.

transitions.entry_phase: planted double support or authored brake pose
transitions.rule: Turn around an established support foot. Preserve the anatomical side of asymmetric headpieces; simple mirroring remains unreviewed.

For a hard interruption, cancel movement immediately and let the existing runtime own cleanup. For a normal authored stop, finish the nearest safe contact transition. Do not delay disable or authorization changes for an animation.

secondary_motion.head: stable identity and gaze; small translation/rotation follows weight transfer
secondary_motion.hair: root follows skull; ends lag body by a few authored frames, never move feet or define floor
secondary_motion.apron_and_skirt: small speed-dependent lag and compression; hem stays a consistent construction and coverage
secondary_motion.theme: quiet cloth/hair weight; no default neon trails, speed-line overlays or unrelated magic

props.book_and_cup: source props ready; matching authored take/use/put-away poses not provided; do not use as permanent floor decoration
props.lifecycle: Appear when the authored hand reaches and grips the prop; stay attached with correct foreground/background occlusion during use; leave with the authored put-away motion. Cancel/disable/skin change clears the whole action and its props.

read_book.status: action art missing; not a ready autonomous/model capability
required_art: same-character seated or standing two-hand support/grip
read_book.usage: Book is supported by hands/lap, with fingers correctly covering its edge; torso and gaze follow reading. It does not float beside the legs.

drink_tea.status: action art missing; not a ready autonomous/model capability
required_art: cup lip meets mouth with correct overlap
drink_tea.usage: Cup scale matches the hand and face; grip and liquid/cup orientation remain plausible. Tea cup is absent from unrelated idle, response and movement.

props.availability: An independent prop image does not make a use action available. Existing local/model selectors should offer read/drink only after matching action art is ready; this file is design guidance, not a new runtime configuration contract.
props.moving_with_prop: requires authored grip and corresponding reduced arm swing; no cup glued to the current open hand
props.stool: embedded in current sit image; no claim of independent stool placement
props.climb_guide: retain current support guide and contact estimates; no new climbing physics platform

final_art_acceptance: same fourth-master face/hair/headpieces, white apron, navy dress, socks and laced low heels in every frame
both halves of the step cycle authored; mirroring one pose does not produce the opposite step
stable camera and body proportions; shared canvas floor with per-foot contact metadata
no world-space drift during support; walk always has support, run has intentional flight
no frame-edge crop, added limb, shoe morph, cloth penetration or opacity flicker
loop endpoint pose and velocity continuity; no duplicate final-frame hold
native contact and hit geometry at multiple sizes and aspect ratios reviewed separately
